chunks: Verily this Qur'an directs you to the path that is straight, and gives happy tidings to those who believe and do the right: For them is a great reward.
ai.seo_question: What are the two main functions of the Qur'an mentioned in Surah Al-Isra?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Qur'an's role as the ultimate criterion (Furqan) that leads to 'al-Qawam', the most upright and balanced path, often interpreted as the Ahl al-Bayt or the straight path of Islam. It establishes a direct causal link between Iman (faith) and Amal al-Salih (righteous deeds), affirming that true belief is manifested through action, thereby securing the 'Ajr al-Kabir' (great reward) in the Hereafter.
